Covers DemandaCsvWizardController (CPU guard, CRLF/UTF-8 normalization), DemandaCsvImportQueueable, Plm_Csv_Import_State__c (resumable cursor), and the LWC DemandaCsvWizard upload UI. Replaces the synchronous ingest path that overflows at scale.

Includes PlmRuleSpecSchemaValidator, bulk/queueable invocables, drift detection via Source_Hash__c, and Track B Batchable mode (Compile_Mode__c).

Implements PlmRuleSpecEvaluator — pure-Apex deterministic AST walker evaluating compiled JSON specs at <50ms/record without LLM at runtime. Covers PlmRuleContextInvocable/Queueable (Id-cursor pagination), decision table lookups (PLM_RuleCatalog, PLM_FieldRuleMapper), verdict writes to Item_Demanda__c.Avaliacao_Regras_JSON__c and Demanda__c.Resumo_Avaliacao_JSON__c, and static Map cache (Platform Cache prohibited).

Cross-cutting reliability layer ensuring zero silent failures. Covers Platform Events (Plm_Compile_Chunk__e → Plm_Compile_Chunk_Log__c with SHA-256 idempotency token), Plm_Compile_Snapshot__c rollups, Dead Letter Queues (Plm_Compile_DLQ__c + Plm_Eval_DLQ__c), Database.Finalizer chain-death recovery, PlmZombieReaperService (5-min Schedulable), and Plm_Batch_Error_Event_TriggerHandler.

Implements the PLM_Diagnostico_Narrativa Einstein Prompt Template pipeline. PlmDiagnosticoNarrativaContextBuilder/Service/Queueable/Invocable assembles validation context per Demanda and invokes the Prompt Template to produce an HTML diagnostic narrative stored in Demanda__c.Diagnostico__c. Reduces analyst investigation time from hours to seconds.

Builds and deploys Agentforce_PLM_Admin Employee Agent — compile-time governance surface. Configures 4 subagents (compile rule, recompile drifted rules, status check, bulk compile), Atlas reasoning engine, planner bundles, and GenAI plugin wiring. This is the primary mechanism for business-led, zero-deployment rule authoring.

Builds and deploys Agentforce_PLM_Ops Employee Agent — runtime operations surface. Configures 6 subagents orchestrating the end-to-end import → evaluate → diagnose loop: CSV ingestion trigger, evaluation kickoff, diagnostic narrative generation, and correction feedback cycle. Provides Claro Ops with a natural-language interface to the full validation pipeline.

Includes DemandaCsvWizard LWC (upload experience; server-side logic in E01). No UX research in scope — Claro SME drives requirements.
